notes: Main run (GPP_NT_VUT_REF, negative GPP set to 0, calendar years, no winter screen). Per site: Z16 = mean GSL/F at 10% of P99 (z16_mean_gsl/z16_mean_f, from derived_site.csv). t85/t95 = the GPP-duration curve's crossing of mean F = 0.85/0.95 -- the first fine-grid threshold (ascending, 0.01-50% of P99) where mean F rounds (6 d.p.) to <= that share; t95 recomputed here from fine_grid.rds and checked to match derived_site.csv's own t95_pct exactly. NA where a site's curve never reaches that share (mean F's maximum stays above it even at 50% of P99, or drops below it before the grid starts).
